- Net.Amount (number)

This seems acceptable because the combined net (5637,10 + 245,00) is an explicit invoice subtotal breakdown. I'll include Net.Amount as 5882.10.

Step 4 — Formatting and decimals
- Maintain number of decimal places as in input (two decimals). For Vat.Rate, input shows "19,0 %": one decimal. Represent as number 19.0.
